en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan, from Jameel, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> cursed at Al-Medina, the one who initiated an event or sheltered an initiator (of a killing)’. I said, ‘And what is the ‘event’?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The killing’.
